title: Customs Ordinance [New Version]
source_id: דמ״י תשי״ז, 39 (New Version, 5717-1957); original at חא״י כרך א׳ פרק מ״ב, עמ׳ 493; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000883; Wikisource page פקודת המכס
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints פקודת המכס [נוסח חדש]; metadata gives the original at חא״י כרך א׳ פרק מ״ב, עמ׳ 493 and the New Version at דמ״י תשי״ז, 39, with Knesset lawitemid 2000883; most recent amendment noted תשפ״ו, 362 (2025/2026). Section headings cover administration and delegation, ports and entry, manifests and declarations, valuation of goods for duty, payment and collection, offences, forfeiture and administrative penalties, bonded warehouses, temporary entry, coastal trade and drawback. The Ordinance does not set duty rates; it refers to the tariff instrument (פקודת תעריף המכס והפטורים) for rates and exemptions.
notes: MANDATE-ERA ORDINANCE in Hebrew New Version form (דמ״י תשי״ז, 39). This is the procedural and enforcement backbone of customs - import entry, declarations, customs valuation (ss 129-134א, which the VAT Law borrows), collection, seizure, forfeiture, smuggling offences, warehousing and drawback - but it does NOT impose the duty. The charge is in the 1937 Customs Tariff and Exemption Ordinance at the rates set by the 2017 tariff order. Both Ordinances are in force simultaneously and the similar names are a genuine trap.
